questions.q: In 'The Pace for Living', what does the author say about his own intelligence test?
options: He would get the first rank
He would score the lowest possible marks
questions.explanation: हचिंसन कहते हैं कि किसी भी बुद्धिमत्ता परीक्षा (intelligence test) में उन्हें सबसे कम अंक मिलेंगे क्योंकि वे धीमी गति से सोचते हैं।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: What was the corn-merchant's attitude toward his wife spending £10 on a holiday?
options: He felt it was a fantastic and extravagant notion
questions.explanation: अनाज व्यापारी अपनी पत्नी की 10 पाउंड खर्च करने की आदत को फिजूलखर्ची मानता था।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: In 'Me and the Ecology Bit', what does Mr. Williams say about the compost pile?
options: That it is not hygiene and smells bad
That it makes the soil rich
That Jim should make it bigger
questions.explanation: मिस्टर विलियम्स के अनुसार खाद का ढेर अस्वास्थ्यकर (not hygiene) है और बदबू फैलाता है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: What did Jim say to Mr. Johnson about his car?
options: That his car is very fast
That he should give Jim a lift
That he should buy a new car
That he should walk to the post office to save ecology
questions.explanation: जिम ने मिस्टर जॉनसन से कहा कि पास के पोस्ट ऑफिस जाने के लिए कार के बजाय पैदल चलना चाहिए।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: In 'Gillu', what did Mahadevi Varma put in Gillu's neck?
options: A lightweight collar of small glass beads
questions.explanation: लेखिका ने गिल्लू के गले में छोटे कांच के मोतियों (glass beads) का एक हल्का कॉलर पहनाया था।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: What did Gillu do when the author was hospitalized after a motor accident?
options: He refused to eat his favorite kaju and kept them in his basket
He ran away to the garden
questions.explanation: लेखिका के अस्पताल में रहने के दौरान गिल्लू ने काजू खाना छोड़ दिया था; उसकी टोकरी काजू से भरी मिली।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: In 'What is Wrong with Indian Films', what does Satyajit Ray say about the raw material of cinema?
questions.explanation: सत्यजित राय कहते हैं कि सिनेमा का कच्चा माल (raw material) स्वयं जीवन (Life itself) है।
questions.subject: English
questions.chapter: What is Wrong with Indian Films

questions.q: According to Satyajit Ray, what was the primary aim of early Indian film producers?
options: To make quick money by imitating Western films
questions.explanation: शुरुआती निर्माताओं का मुख्य उद्देश्य पश्चिमी फिल्मों की नकल कर रातोंरात मुनाफा कमाना था।
questions.subject: English
questions.chapter: What is Wrong with Indian Films

questions.q: How does Mahadevi Varma describe the spring season in 'Gillu'?
options: When the Sonjuhi creeper is covered with yellow buds
questions.explanation: वसंत ऋतु में सोनजुही की लता पीली कलियों से लद जाती थी, जो गिल्लू की याद दिलाती थी।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: What does Satyajit Ray consider the most important quality of a director?
questions.explanation: निर्देशक के पास सत्यनिष्ठा और वास्तविकता के प्रति सम्मान होना चाहिए।
questions.subject: English
questions.chapter: What is Wrong with Indian Films

questions.q: In 'Acceptance Speech', who does Alexander Aris say the Nobel Prize truly belongs to?
options: To all the people of Burma who are struggling for democracy
questions.explanation: अलेक्जेंडर एरिस के अनुसार यह पुरस्कार बर्मा के उन सभी लोगों का है जो लोकतंत्र के लिए संघर्ष कर रहे हैं।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: What does Alexander Aris say about his mother's reaction to the Nobel Prize?
options: She would buy a big house
She would be very proud of herself
She would say that the prize belongs not to her, but to all those men, women, and children of Burma
questions.explanation: सू ची का मानना था कि यह सम्मान उनके देश के संघर्षरत नागरिकों का है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: In 'Once Upon a Time', what is the reputation of the old blind woman?
options: She is known to be both the law and its transgression
She is known to be foolish
She is known to be cruel
She is known to be rich
questions.explanation: कहानी में उस अंधी महिला को कानून और उसका उल्लंघन दोनों माना जाता है (असीम ज्ञान की प्रतीक)।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: What does Toni Morrison say about the future of language in her essay?
options: We die. That may be the meaning of life. But we do language. That may be the measure of our lives.
questions.explanation: मॉरिसन कहती हैं कि भाषा ही हमारे जीवन का वास्तविक माप (measure of our lives) है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: In 'The Unity of Indian Culture', what does Humayun Kabir say about the Aryan invasion?
options: They never met the local people
They brought a new civilization and synthesized with the existing pre-Aryan culture
questions.explanation: आर्यों ने भारत आकर यहाँ की पूर्व-आर्य संस्कृति के साथ समन्वय (synthesis) स्थापित किया।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: What is the role of 'tolerance' in Indian culture according to Humayun Kabir?
options: It is the essential condition for the survival of India's unity in diversity
questions.explanation: सहिष्णुता (tolerance) भारत की 'विविधता में एकता' को बनाए रखने की अनिवार्य शर्त है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: In 'Little Girls Wiser Than Men', what were Akoulya and Malasha wearing on Easter?
options: Akoulya wore a yellow frock and Malasha wore a blue frock
questions.explanation: अकूल्या ने पीली फ्रॉक और मलाशा ने नीली फ्रॉक पहनी हुई थी।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: What did Akoulya say to Malasha before entering the puddle?
options: 'Don't step in so, Malasha. Your mother will scold you. Let us take off our shoes and stockings.'
questions.explanation: अकूल्या ने मलाशा से कहा कि जूते-मोजे उतारकर पानी में चलें ताकि कपड़े खराब न हों।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: How did the men react when they saw the little girls' water channel?
options: They stopped fighting, looked at the children, and laughed at their own folly
questions.explanation: बच्चियों की समझदारी देखकर पुरुष अपनी मूर्खता पर हँस पड़े और झगड़ा बंद कर दिया।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: What is the central philosophical takeaway from Tolstoy's story?
options: Children harbor no malice and forgive quickly, unlike egoistic adults
questions.explanation: बच्चे मन में बैर नहीं रखते और तुरंत एक हो जाते हैं, जबकि बड़े अंहकार में लड़ते रहते हैं।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: In 'God Made the Country', what does Cowper say about the 'chariots and sedans'?
options: They are the luxurious conveyances of the townspeople that cause idleness
questions.explanation: कवि बताता है कि शहरों की बग्घियां और पालकी (chariots and sedans) लोगों को आलसी बनाती हैं।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: What is the specific virtue of the country according to William Cowper?
options: It offers a tranquil environment where virtue and health can thrive naturally
questions.explanation: गाँव का शांत वातावरण स्वास्थ्य और सदाचार (virtue and health) के विकास के लिए सर्वोत्तम है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: In 'Ode on Solitude', what does Alexander Pope say about the happy man's sleep?
questions.explanation: सुखी व्यक्ति रात में अत्यंत गहरी और निश्चिंत नींद (sound sleep) का आनंद लेता है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: What does Alexander Pope mean by 'quiet by day'?
options: A peaceful, stress-free daily routine without worldly ambitions
questions.explanation: 'Quiet by day' का अर्थ है सांसारिक महत्वाकांक्षाओं से मुक्त, सादगीपूर्ण और शांत दिनचर्या।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: In 'Polythene Bag', what happens when the bag is left in the garbage bin?
options: It becomes a breeding ground for deadly germs and pollutes the environment
questions.explanation: कूड़ेदान में पड़ा पॉलीथिन घातक कीटाणुओं का घर बन जाता है और पर्यावरण को दूषित करता है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: How does Durga Prasad Panda describe the emotional 'hurt' in the poem?
options: It is like a polythene bag that cannot be destroyed and melts with a little touch of warmth
questions.explanation: मन की पुरानी चोट पॉलीथिन की तरह होती है जो थोड़ी सी भावना की आंच पाकर पिघलने (उभरने) लगती है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: In 'Thinner Than a Crescent', what do Radha's friends report to Lord Krishna?
options: That Radha is fading away day by day like the crescent moon due to his absence
questions.explanation: सखियाँ श्रीकृष्ण को बताती हैं कि उनके वियोग में राधा दूज के चाँद की तरह क्षीण (कमजोर) हो रही हैं।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: What is the significance of the word 'Madhava' in Vidyapati's poem?
options: It is the name of a river
It is a beautiful name for Lord Krishna used by Radha's friends
It is the name of a mountain
It is the name of a village
questions.explanation: कविता में 'माधव' (Madhava) शब्द भगवान श्रीकृष्ण के लिए प्रयुक्त हुआ है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: What is the poetic device used in 'Thinner Than a Crescent'?
options: Simile and Hyperbole (exaggerating her thinness and tears)
questions.explanation: राधा की कमजोरी और आंसुओं की नदी के वर्णन में उपमा (Simile) और अतिशयोक्ति (Hyperbole) का सुंदर प्रयोग है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: What is the ultimate message of Cowper's 'God Made the Country'?
options: Rural simplicity is far superior to urban luxury and artificiality
questions.explanation: ग्रामीण सादगी और प्राकृतिक जीवन शहरी सुख-सुविधाओं और बनावटीपन से कहीं अधिक श्रेष्ठ है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: In 'The Empty Heart', what is the rich man's prayer to the Kalpaka tree?
options: To give him a pot of gold
questions.explanation: अमीर आदमी ने कल्पवृक्ष से सोने से भरा एक घड़ा (pot of gold) मांगा था।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: What does Periasamy Thooran call the eighth pitcher?
options: The 'half-full' pitcher that became a curse of endless greed
questions.explanation: आधा भरा आठवां घड़ा अमीर आदमी के लिए अंतहीन लालच का अभिशाप बन गया।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: In 'Koel', what does Puran Singh mean by 'What lightning fell? What singed thy wings?'
options: He is asking about forest fire
He is asking about actual rain
He is asking what intense sorrow of love has burnt the Koel's soul and wings
questions.explanation: कवि कोयल से पूछता है कि विरह की किस बिजली ने उसके पंखों और आत्मा को झुलसा दिया है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: What makes the Koel's song so poignant in Puran Singh's poem?
options: The intense fire of separation (Biraha) from her beloved
questions.explanation: प्रियतम से विरह (Biraha) की तीव्र आग कोयल के गीत को अत्यंत मार्मिक बना देती है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: In 'The Sleeping Porter', what is the physical setting of the porter's journey?
options: A snow-clad, treacherous mountain cliff under freezing winds
questions.explanation: कुली बर्फीली हवाओं के बीच बर्फ से ढकी एक दुर्गम पहाड़ी पर चढ़ाई कर रहा है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: What does Laxmi Prasad Devkota say about the porter's hut?
options: His hut is a grand palace
His hut is in the city
His hut is full of gold
His hut is below on the cliff, where his wife and son are shivering with cold and hunger
questions.explanation: पहाड़ी के नीचे उसकी छोटी सी झोपड़ी है जहाँ उसकी पत्नी और बेटा ठंड और भूख से कांप रहे हैं।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: In 'Martha', what is the physical posture of Martha while telling stories?
options: Her two slim hands clasped around her bended knees
questions.explanation: मार्था अपने घुटनों को मोड़कर अपने दोनों पतले हाथों से उन्हें पकड़कर बैठती थी।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: How does Walter de la Mare describe the effect of Martha's stories on the quiet glen?
options: The glen falls into a magical, dreamlike silence
questions.explanation: मार्था की कहानी सुनते ही पूरी हरी-भरी घाटी जादुई और सपनमयी शांति में डूब जाती थी।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: What is the common underlying theme between 'The Sleeping Porter' and 'The Empty Heart'?
options: The contrast between material greed and humble, hard-working contentment
questions.explanation: 'The Empty Heart' में लालच का विनाश है, जबकि 'The Sleeping Porter' में कठिन श्रम के बाद संतोष की नींद है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: What does the Koel symbolize in Indian poetic tradition as depicted by Puran Singh?
options: The eternal lover pining for union with the divine beloved
questions.explanation: कोयल प्रियतम (ईश्वर) से मिलन के लिए तड़पते शाश्वत प्रेमी का प्रतीक है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct sentence: ________ I a king, I would help the poor.
questions.explanation: 'If I were a king' को Inversion (बिना If के) में 'Were I a king' लिखा जाता है; यह अत्यंत मानक है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct sentence: ________ he worked hard, he would have passed.
questions.explanation: 'If he had worked hard' का Inversion रूप 'Had he worked hard' होता है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct sentence: ________ you see him, give him my message.
questions.explanation: Open condition में 'If you see him' के स्थान पर 'Should you see him' का प्रयोग बहुत औपचारिक और सही है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct verb form: You will not pass ________ you work hard.
questions.explanation: शर्त (condition - यदि नहीं) दर्शाने के लिए 'unless' का प्रयोग किया जाता है ('until' समय के लिए होता है)।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct verb form: Wait here ________ I return.
questions.explanation: समय (time - जब तक कि नहीं) दर्शाने के लिए 'until' या 'till' का प्रयोग किया जाता है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct verb form: If she ________ here, she would help me.
questions.explanation: काल्पनिक स्थिति (Subjunctive) में Singular Subject (she) के साथ भी 'were' लगता है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct verb form: If I had money, I ________ buy a car.
questions.explanation: Second conditional (If + V2/had) के साथ दूसरे भाग में 'would + V1' लगता है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct verb form: If you had called me, I ________ come.
questions.explanation: Third conditional (If + had V3) के साथ 'would have + V3' का प्रयोग अनिवार्य है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct verb form: If the sun shines, we ________ for a picnic.
questions.explanation: First conditional में 'If + Present Simple' के साथ 'will + V1' लगता है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct sentence: ________ I known the truth, I would have told you.
questions.explanation: 'Had I known' (यदि मुझे पता होता) Past Perfect Conditional का Inversion रूप है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct verb form: He enjoys ________ cricket.
questions.explanation: 'Enjoy', 'Avoid', 'Mind', 'Stop' के बाद हमेशा Gerund (V1+ing) का प्रयोग होता है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct verb form: She avoided ________ to him.
questions.explanation: 'Avoid' (बचना) के बाद Gerund (talking) का प्रयोग अनिवार्य रूप से किया जाता है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct verb form: He made me ________.
questions.explanation: 'Make' (made) के Active Voice में हमेशा Bare Infinitive (बिना to के V1 - weep) लगता है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct verb form: Let him ________ now.
questions.explanation: 'Let' के बाद हमेशा Bare Infinitive (बिना to के V1 - go) का प्रयोग किया जाता है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct verb form: I saw him ________ the road.
questions.explanation: 'See' (saw) के बाद Present Participle (crossing) या Bare Infinitive (cross) लगता है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct verb form: ________ is a good exercise.
questions.explanation: Gerund (Walking) का प्रयोग Subject के रूप में हुआ है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct verb form: He is fond of ________ songs.
questions.explanation: Preposition (of, in, at, for) के बाद हमेशा Gerund (V1+ing) का प्रयोग होता है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct verb form: She went to the market ________ a pen.
questions.explanation: उद्देश्य (purpose) दर्शाने के लिए Infinitive (to buy) का प्रयोग किया जाता है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct verb form: Would you mind ________ the window?
questions.explanation: 'Would you mind...' के बाद हमेशा Gerund (opening) का प्रयोग अत्यंत मानक है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct verb form: ________ a loud noise, the boy woke up.
questions.explanation: Present Participle (Hearing - सुनकर) का प्रयोग कर वाक्य शुरू किया गया है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct word: All students were present ________ Mohan.
questions.explanation: 'Except' (के सिवाय / को छोड़कर) का प्रयोग सही है ('Accept' का अर्थ स्वीकार करना होता है)।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct word: The new rule will not ________ our salary.
questions.explanation: 'Affect' (प्रभावित करना - Verb) का प्रयोग होगा ('Effect' सामान्यतः Noun होता है)।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct word: Mr. Sharma is the ________ of our college.
questions.explanation: 'Principal' (प्रधानाचार्य / मुख्य) सही है ('Principle' का अर्थ सिद्धांत या नियम होता है)।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct translation: जहाँ चाह, वहाँ राह।
options: Where there is will, there is way.
Where is a will, there is a way.
Where is will, there is way.
Where there is a will, there is a way.
questions.explanation: यह अंग्रेजी की एक अत्यंत प्रसिद्ध लोकोक्ति (Proverb) है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct translation: भौंकने वाले कुत्ते काटते नहीं।
questions.explanation: 'Barking dogs seldom bite' (गरजने वाले बरसते नहीं) एक मानक लोकोक्ति है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct translation: अंत भला तो सब भला।
options: Everything is well that ends well.
All is well that end well.
questions.explanation: महान नाटककार शेक्सपियर के नाटक के शीर्षक पर आधारित प्रसिद्ध लोकोक्ति।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct translation: नाच न जाने आँगन टेढ़ा।
options: A bad workman quarreling with tools.
A bad workman quarrels with his tools.
A bad dancer blames the courtyard.
A bad worker fights with tools.
questions.explanation: यह अंग्रेजी का सटीक और मानक मुहावरेदार अनुवाद है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: What is the synonym of 'Enormous'?
questions.explanation: 'Enormous' (विशाल/बहुत बड़ा) का पर्यायवाची 'Huge' है।
questions.subject: English
